title: Introduce invocation context entropy metric and cost-synthesis gadget
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: We have recurring noisy long-tail alerts that correlate with high-variance token shapes and divergent prompt contexts. This PR introduces a lightweight invocation-level 'context_entropy' metric and a cost-synthesis enrichment that attaches an approximate per-invocation token-cost signature to traces and logs. The goal is to make long-tail cost/latency contributors visible in dashboards and to reduce alert noise by giving SREs an actionable signal to mute context-driven bursts.

What I changed: added a new metric invocation.context_entropy (double, low-cardinality taggable by route/model/tenant), implemented a best-effort cost_synth step in the tracing sidecar that computes a compact token-cost fingerprint and cost_bucket tag (cheap/medium/expensive). Instrumentation added in the serving runtime to emit the entropy and an estimated token_cost_delta field to spans. A new dashboard panel (dashboards/invocation_entropy_panel.json) visualizes entropy vs 95th-percentile token_cost_delta and provides a cohort selector by model and route. I also added an alert tuning recipe and an alert rule (monitoring/alerts/entropy_suppressed_token_burst.yaml) that uses entropy-weighted suppression to avoid firing on contextual surges where entropy exceeds a configurable threshold.

Implementation notes: the entropy calculation is intentionally approximate: it samples prefix token distributions (using existing sampling hooks) up to a configurable window (default 128 tokens) and computes an integer-quantized Shannon estimate to keep storage and emission costs minimal. The cost_synth step uses token length + kv_cache_hit_ratio + quantized_attention_sparsity as inputs to a small linear model (weights embedded in runtime config) to estimate per-invocation token_cost_delta. The tracing enrichment is non-blocking and will not change request latencies when disabled via feature-flag.

Files & surface area: modified runtime metric emitter (src/serving/metrics/entropy_emitter.go), tracing sidecar enrichment (src/tracing/enrich/cost_synth.go), trace schema mapping (pkg/trace/schema_v2.go), dashboards (dashboards/invocation_entropy_panel.json), alerting rules (monitoring/alerts/entropy_suppressed_token_burst.yaml), a small synthetic replay test harness (tests/replay/synthetic_entropy_replay.py) and docs/playbooks (docs/observability/context-entropy.md).

Testing & rollout: unit tests added for the entropy estimator and the cost_synth model (tests/unit/entropy_estimator_test.go, tests/unit/cost_synth_test.go). Integration tested on canary with synthetic replay of 50k invocations across three prompt shapes; CI initially failed linting on a dashboard JSON, was fixed and rerun. Feature-flag rollout planned: off by default; enable for 10% of traffic in staging for 48 hours, then 50% for 24 hours, then full rollout if no SLO regression.

Related: Linear items ENG-3245 (observability long-tail), ENG-3310 (token-cost instrumentation). Links: Linear/ENG-3245; Runbook: docs/observability/context-entropy.md.

Migration & backward compatibility: the new metric is additive and doesn't change existing metrics. Tracing enrichment adds new tags but leaves existing spans untouched when the feature is disabled. No breaking changes expected.

2025-11-15 - Sofia Martinez: Alert rule looks promising but we should default to conservative suppression thresholds and make the window configurable per-tenant.
2025-11-16 - Maya Chen (author): Made suppression threshold tenant-configurable and added a knob in monitoring/alerts/entropy_suppressed_token_burst.yaml with sensible defaults.
2025-11-17 - Evan Liu: In canary run we saw a small spike in trace size; please add size guard to synthesized tags to avoid exceeding binary proto limits.

release_notes: Added invocation.context_entropy metric and a non-blocking cost_synth tracing enrichment. New dashboard panel for entropy vs cost and an entropy-weighted alert suppression rule. Feature gated and rolled out incrementally. See docs/observability/context-entropy.md for playbook and tuning guidance.
